title: Olive's Gift in the Box
checkpoint: Year 1 Spring 1, week 2 — School readiness — Phase 5: new ways to say and spell i, o, o, u
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations u as yoo, c as s, g as j.

pages.text: Olive spots a box on the sill.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl perched on a windowsill, looking down at a small wooden box filled with soil and flowers.

pages.text: Olive wants to make a gift for Nell.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl looking thoughtfully at the flower box, an idea forming.

pages.text: Olive picks a bright petal from the box.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl gently plucking a single bright pink petal from a flower in the box.

pages.text: Olive picks a green leaf too.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl picking a small green leaf from the same flower box.

pages.text: Olive sets the petal on the leaf.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl placing the bright petal carefully on top of the green leaf.

pages.text: Olive ties the leaf with a thin stem.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl wrapping a thin plant stem around the leaf and petal to hold them together.

pages.text: The gift is bright and neat.
pages.illustration: A small, neat bundle of petal and leaf tied with a stem, resting on the windowsill.

pages.text: Olive gets the gift to Nell.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl flying with the small gift held carefully, Nell the bee waiting below.

pages.text: Nell sees the gift. Nell grins big.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee smiling widely as Olive presents the little petal gift to her.

pages.text: Olive is glad Nell likes it.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl and Nell the bee together, both happy, the gift held between them.
